question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word used in the passage. **Aggravate**
solution:
The correct answer is Option (2) i.e. **"Alleviate".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aggravate: (बिगाड़ना)** - To make a bad situation or a problem worse

 
 
• **Example**: Loud music tends to aggravate my headaches.
 
 
 
• **Alleviate: (हल्का करना)** - To make less severe
 
 
• **Example**: The new road will alleviate the traffic congestion in town.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Alleviate**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pester: (परेशान करना)** - Annoy someone with frequent or persistent requests or interruptions
 
• **Annihilate: (नष्ट करना) **- Destroy utterly; obliterate
 
• **Destroy: (नष्ट करना)** - Put an end to the existence of something by damaging or attacking it
